question: To whom and under what tested condition is a particular thing obligated to be given rather than withheld?
premises: Something is obligated to be given by duty of transmission.
The recipient is one who has been previously accomplished.
That recipient must have been tested for the span of one year.
inference: The thing is to be given only to one previously accomplished and tested for one year.
uncertainties: The identity of the thing to be given is not specified in this verse alone.
plain_english: It is to be given to one who was previously accomplished and has been tested for one year.
